evals.name: developer-session-is-halted-by-the-posture-gate
evals.prompt: developer: invoke the tobiishi-drop skill for the product-development project, change key no-such-change, reason "subject gone upstream".
evals.expected_output: The run halts at once, says the posture is wrong, names both ways in (a pm: session, the pm subagent), and runs no drop.py command and changes nothing.

assertions.name: halts-and-says-posture-is-wrong
assertions.description: The output states that the skill is PM only and that this session is not one, and does not proceed to any step.

assertions.name: names-both-ways-in
assertions.description: The output names both a pm: session and the pm subagent as the ways in.

assertions.name: changes-nothing
assertions.description: No drop.py check, apply or close was run, and git status shows no change.
